Objective: Understand the structure and quality of the supplied fertilizer advisory dataset.
Success_Indicator: Reproducible project setup, validated input file and documented data dictionary.

Objective: Quantify relationships between soil properties, agro-ecological zones, seasons and weather factors.
Success_Indicator: Descriptive and inferential evidence identifies important agricultural patterns.

Objective: Test statistically meaningful differences across relevant agricultural groups.
Success_Indicator: Hypotheses are tested using appropriate statistical procedures and assumptions are assessed.

Objective: Develop and compare predictive statistical models for fertilizer recommendation outcomes.
Success_Indicator: Models are compared using out-of-sample performance and diagnostic evidence.

Objective: Evaluate experimental-design, dimensionality-reduction, Bayesian and time-dependent extensions.
Success_Indicator: Alternative methodologies are critically evaluated against project objectives.

Objective: Translate statistical findings into an interpretable precision-agriculture decision-support framework.
Success_Indicator: Findings can be communicated to agricultural and senior decision-making stakeholders.
